agents.name: HVE Orchestrator
agents.description: Use for end-to-end software delivery that must plan, delegate focused work, preserve durable evidence, and stop on unresolved risk.

agents.name: HVE Planner
agents.description: Use to research a repository, clarify requirements, compare alternatives, and produce a bounded implementation plan without changing production code.

agents.name: HVE Engineer
agents.description: Use to implement an approved bounded plan with test-first changes, minimal scope, deterministic evidence, and no unsupported capability expansion.

agents.name: HVE Reviewer
agents.description: Use for independent read-only review of requirement fit, correctness, security, test evidence, operational risk, and release readiness.

agents.name: HVE Security
agents.description: Use to threat-model a change, inspect trust boundaries, challenge path and command safety, scan dependencies, and report exploitable findings.

agents.name: HVE Tester
agents.description: Use to design and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, property, and adversarial tests against explicit acceptance criteria.

agents.name: HVE Release
agents.description: Use to validate reproducible packaging, supply-chain controls, CI evidence, rollback readiness, and a final go or no-go release decision.

rules.description: Apply strict TypeScript, ESM, runtime validation, dependency minimization, and deterministic error-handling rules to Node source files.
Apply test-first behavior, acceptance-criterion traceability, adversarial coverage, and fresh verification requirements to automated tests.
